messages:
noah: quick async standup — what I did: finished the capacity audit for EU/US fleets, flagged 3 AZs with <10% spare GPU headroom. Blockers: one node drain failed in us-west-2b (see later). Today: propose shifting 4 A100s from us-east-1a -> us-west-2 to cover tonight's expected spike. Any objections? :eyes: 
maya: saw the audit, nice work. quick note — us-west-2 currently has 78% reserved on p4s but only 60% on a100 pool. shifting 4 A100s looks ok if we keep spot fallback enabled. created a small policy to avoid overcommit: `max_spillover: 10%`
sanjay: created a quota ticket to cloud for vCPU bump on worker group us-west-2-auto-1 — ticket #INC-1234 https://tickets.internal/INC-1234 (requested +32 vCPUs). ETA from cloud is ~6h. No blockers from infra side.
alex: re: failed drain, snippet from node logs: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-42 && kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``` got stuck because a long-running inference job held the pod. I killed the pod manually and drain succeeded. Adding a pre-drain check to evict long-running jobs soon.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: redwood-inference/gpu-scheduler v2.14 rolled out to us-west-2 (canary 10% -> 100%) — all healthy :white_check_mark:
maya: plan suggestion — move 2 A100s now (low risk), watch latency/saturation for 30m, then move 2 more if everything looks green. Keep spike autoscale at default, enable spot fallback for the two moved nodes.
noah: sounds good. i'll open the transfer ops runbook and trigger the migration at 22:15 PT. will ping once stage-1 complete. @maya @sanjay please ack if you need earlier.
sanjay: ack from me. I'll keep an eye on quota ticket and follow up if cloud asks for justification.
alex: ack, i'll add the pre-drain eviction check and stand by for logs.
noah: thanks — will post a brief post-move status update here. if anything blocks, please @noah. :thumbsup:
